note: R-03 — the Anthropic Messages research note
provenance_meaning: Every JSON fixture in this directory was hand-authored from the primary Anthropic documentation and from the shipped type definitions of @anthropic-ai/sdk@0.123.0 (a .d.ts read — a type contract, not an executed call). None was captured from a live API call: no credential was available in the research environment. W4-GW-01 must replay these against the real API once the Owner supplies a key (plan §6.2 PL-3) and re-mark this field "verified". This blanket label is a floor, not a guarantee about every value: entries in the "fixtures" array below may carry their own "provenance" override and a "caveat", and where they do, those take precedence over this field.
exception: sdk-header-probe.md is the one artefact here backed by executed code: the SDK was driven against a local node:http stub server and the request headers it emitted were recorded. It still contacted no real API.
fact_check_round_1: stream-thinking.json previously asserted the display:"omitted" default with no citation and an incomplete model list. The claim was re-checked against https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking and confirmed, and the fixture gained a verbatim citation. The model list it gained was still incomplete — see fact_check_round_2.
fact_check_round_2: The round-1 repair cited the Thinking page's 'thinking is already on and needs no configuration' sentence, which lists seven models and scopes thinking-on-by-default rather than the display default. The authoritative list is in the page's 'Controlling thinking display' section and names nine models, adding Claude Opus 4.8 and Claude Opus 4.7. stream-thinking.json now carries that section's verbatim text, the nine-model display_default_scope, the separate seven-model thinking_on_by_default_scope, and the 'summarized'-default scope. A conformance case for Opus 4.8/4.7 must expect no thinking_delta events unless it sets display:'summarized' explicitly. See the 'Fact-check round 2' section of the note.

rules: The SSE event name always equals the data object's "type".
There is NO "data: [DONE]" terminator — it was removed in anthropic-version 2023-06-01.
ping and error events may appear anywhere in the stream.
Readers must tolerate unknown event names (versioning policy).
usage token counts on message_delta are CUMULATIVE.

fixtures.scenario_41: system prompt, multi-turn conversation, prompt caching

fixtures.caveat: Illustrative values, and the pair is NOT replay-ready as written. cache_read_input_tokens: 1024 presupposes a cached system prefix at or above claude-opus-5's 512-token minimum cacheable prefix (R-03 F7); below that floor a prefix silently does not cache and BOTH cache counters come back 0. The `system` block in messages-system-multiturn.request.json is a 26-character stand-in far under that floor, so replaying that body verbatim returns cache_read_input_tokens: 0, not 1024. Pad the system block past the model's minimum before using this pair as the prompt-caching conformance case (W4-GW-01).

READ BEFORE ASSERTING ON `usage`. The numbers are copied from the prompt-caching documentation example reproduced in R-03 F7, and they satisfy input_tokens == cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens (2048 == 1800 + 248), which reads as input_tokens being the TOTAL. R-03 F7's own arithmetic rule says the opposite: total_input_tokens = cache_read + cache_creation + input_tokens, with input_tokens counting only post-breakpoint tokens, which would make the total 4096 here. Both readings cannot hold. Resolve against a live response (W4-GW-01) before any conformance case asserts a total; the fixture is retained as the documented example, not as an attested total.

fixtures.provenance: documented (field names) + inferred (numeric values — see caveat)
fixtures.caveat: Field names are from the List Models reference and the probed ModelInfo (R-03 F10). The VALUES are not all documented: max_input_tokens 1000000 and max_tokens 128000 are an INFERENCE, filled in from the Models overview table because the reference page's own /v1/models example prints 0 for both, and created_at, first_id and last_id are invented. R-03's Contract summary flags exactly these as illustrative/inferred. A conformance case must assert the field names and types here, not these numbers.
